apps.name: House Help Tracker
apps.tagline: Attendance, salary and UPI pay for your house help, plus expiry reminders.
apps.shareText: House Help Tracker: free app for attendance, salary and UPI pay for your house help, plus expiry reminders.

screenshots.caption: Pay worked out to the paisa
Scan or say the name and date

apps.about: House Help Tracker keeps a simple record for the people who help run your home: your cook, maid, car cleaner, driver, or a stand-in who helps for a few days. Every day counts as present unless you mark it otherwise, and pay is worked out for you.

features.title: Attendance in one tap
points: Absent, half day, planned leave, weekly off or paid holiday
Plan leave ahead for festivals and trips home
A paid holiday for everyone at once

features.title: Pay worked out for you
points: Free leaves, bonus, advances in instalments
Pay by UPI with the amount filled in
Raises never change months already paid

features.title: Slips and reports on WhatsApp
points: Detailed pay slip as a message or picture
Monthly report of everyone's pay and dues
Leave messages in English, Hindi or Marathi

features.title: Expiry tracker for the home
points: Add a photo of each product
Scan or say the name and expiry date
Reminders 7 days before and on the day

features.title: Private by design
points: No sign-up, no account, no ads
All records stay on your phone
Backup and restore, light and dark mode

dataSafety.title: Your records stay on your phone
dataSafety.text: Names, numbers, pay, attendance and items are never sent to the developer or anyone else.

dataSafety.title: No ads, no tracking
dataSafety.text: The app has no ads and no analytics of its own.

dataSafety.title: Google diagnostics for scanning
dataSafety.text: Google ML Kit, used to read packs on the phone, may send Google basic diagnostics such as phone model and app performance. Photos are never sent.

notes: Paid leave: give your cook, maid or any house help a full day or half day of paid leave. Tap a day → More → Paid leave or Paid half day, and add the reason. No money is cut for it.
The reason shows in the month's leave log, and paid leave days are listed on the pay slip.

Free trial is now 45 days: every feature is free for 45 days from when you first used version 1.21 or later. After that, one house help with attendance and pay stays free, and Pro (₹49 a month or ₹399 a year) unlocks everything.
Send feedback and Share the app in Settings now open the app's page on appbucket.in.
